data.name: Murtaqa
data.gender_notes: Murtaqa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is accepted by Allah. The name Murtaqa carries the meaning “Accepted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Murtaqa usually hope their child will grow to embody accepted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who has achieved a high level of spiritual purity and has been accepted by Allah
data.etymology: Murtaqa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Accepted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtaqa total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مُرتَقى
in_arabic.meaning: المرتقى، المرتقى، المرتقى بالله، المرتقى بالسماء
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُرتَقى: الفعل المضارع من الرُقى، وَالرُقى: الارتقاء، والصعود. ويُطلق على الشخص الذي يرتقي بالصبر والصالحين. والمرتقى بالله: الذي يرتقي من حيث الدنيا إلى حيث الآخرة. والمُرتَقى بالسماء: الذي يرتقي من حيث الأرض إلى حيث السماء. وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى. ومن أسماء الصديقين، والصالحين، والمتقون. ويكون هذا الاسم نقيضًا للسمعى، ويكون له تأثير قوي في التغلب على الصعاب، والاستمرار في العمل الصالح.

in_urdu.name: مُرتَقى
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرتقا: وہ شخص جو اللہ کی رضا کے لیے زندگی گزارے اور اللہ کے راستے پر چلے۔ مرتقا اللہ: وہ شخص جو اللہ کی رضا حاصل کرنے کے لیے زندگی گزارے اور اللہ کی راہ میں ہمیشہ تلوار چلانے کے لیے تیار رہے۔ مرتقا آسمانوں: وہ شخص جو اللہ کی رضا حاصل کرنے کے لیے زندگی گزارے اور اللہ کی راہ میں ہمیشہ تلوار چلانے کے لیے تیار رہے۔ یہ نام اللہ کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुर्ताका
in_hindi.long_meaning: मर्ताका: जो شخص अल्लाह की रज़ा के लिए ज़िंदगी बसर करता है और अल्लाह के रास्ते पर चलता है। मर्ताका अल्लाह: जो व्यक्ति अल्लाह की रज़ा प्राप्त करने के लिए ज़िंदगी बसर करता है और अल्लाह के रास्ते पर चलता है। मर्ताका आसमान: जो व्यक्ति अल्लाह की रज़ा प्राप्त करने के लिए ज़िंदगी बसर करता है और अल्लाह के रास्ते पर चलता है। यह नाम अल्लाह के लिए भी उपयोग किया जाता है।

It is a name that evokes a sense of reverence and admiration in the community, as it signifies an individual who strives to live a righteous life and aims to please Allah through their actions and deeds.
data.spiritual_significance: Murtaqa is a deeply spiritual name that speaks to the very core of Islamic faith and practice. It represents an individual who has transcended the mundane aspects of life and has dedicated themselves to seeking closeness and pleasure from Allah. The name serves as a constant reminder of the ultimate goal of all human endeavor - to please Allah and attain His approval. It is a name that instills a sense of calm and peace, as it represents the culmination of a life spent in devotion and service to Allah.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Murtaqa' holds significant meaning in Islamic spirituality and Sufism, representing a person who has attained a high level of spiritual realization and is considered a 'Friend of Allah.' In modern contexts, this name is seen on various digital platforms as a community and source of inspiration for individuals seeking personal growth, mental health, and self-care in the Islamic tradition. Instagram accounts (@murtaqa_sufi) and Facebook groups (@MurtaqaSufiCommunity) serve as spaces for sharing inspirational quotes, Islamic teachings, and personal stories of spiritual growth. YouTube channels (Murtaqa Sufi) provide educational content on Islamic spirituality, Sufism, and mental health practices, offering guidance and resources for those on their spiritual journeys. These platforms reflect a growing trend towards digital communities and resources for spiritual and personal development in the Islamic tradition.
